thread:
rani: FYI keystore rotation kicked in eu-west-1 at 03:14 UTC and we're seeing a cascade: GPU-serving pods dropping batching windows and nodes getting drained.
josh: saw that — what error lines are we seeing in the model-proxy logs?
rani: paste logs below from model-proxy on svc/gpu-infer-1 (trimmed):\n```
2024-11-02T03:15:12Z ERROR auth: failed decrypt keyid=arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:xxxx:key/abcd status=AccessDenied
2024-11-02T03:15:12Z WARN kvcache: miss key=prefix-abc
2024-11-02T03:15:13Z ERROR request: batch-window empty len=0 route=/v1/generate
```
alex: ^^ looks like rotation removed a grant for the service role used by the warm-pool keystore proxy. autoscaler sees starvation and starts cordoning/evicting to rebalance.
lisa: confirmed in cluster events: `Pod gpu-infer-1-7b6c Tainted: node.kubernetes.io/unschedulable` followed by `Draining` logs. warm-pool warmup hit 0 tokens. :grimacing:
sre-bot: alert: keystore-decrypt-failure spike (rate=220/min) — correlated w/ key rotation job `keystore-rotation-v2`.
josh: can we rollback the rotation key policy? who's owning the rotation job?
rani: rotation job was executed by infra/keystore-ops at 03:12. owner @alex. suggest revert policy to previous grant for role `infra-keystore-proxy-role`.
alex: I'm on it. Rolling policy revert now (iam console + terraform rollback). Will post status.
deploy-bot: Started run: terraform apply --target=aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.keystore_proxy_attach (run id: tf-2321)
rani: quick mitigation while revert propagates — we can patch model-proxy container env to point to the fallback keystore endpoint (non-rotated) and restart pods to rehydrate KV cache. low-risk, but needs coord.
lisa: patch + rolling restart seems fastest. I can apply the k8s patch: `kubectl set env deploy/model-proxy KEYSTORE_ENDPOINT=https://keystore-fallback.internal` and then `kubectl rollout restart deploy/model-proxy`.
josh: add monitoring queries to watch batch-window length and kvcache hit-rate:\n- datadog: `avg:gpu.infer.batch_window_len{region:eu-west-1}`\n- datadog: `rate(auth.decrypt.errors{service:model-proxy}.rollup(sum,60))`
rani: also add a short-term autoscaler hold to avoid aggressive eviction until kvcache returns: patch HPA to set minReplicas to currentReplicas for 10m.
alex: revert applied, IAM shows role attachment restored (console: https://console.aws.amazon.com/iam/home?region=eu-west-1#roles/infra-keystore-proxy-role). confirming propagation across accounts.
rani: lisa — go ahead with fallback patch now. I'll coordinate with SRE to lift HPA after rollout. tagging #oncall for watch.
lisa: applying patch in 30s. will post rollout status.
deploy-bot: terraform apply complete (tf-2321) — 1 resource updated.
lisa: rollout status: 6/6 updated, model-proxy pods back to Running. kvcache hit-rate climbing \u2191
josh: batch-window len recovering (observed 0 -> 12 -> 48 tokens) :tada:
rani: nice. follow-ups: 1) add pre-rotation check to verify role grants and cross-account policies, 2) add a canary rotation flag to rotate a single shard first, 3) update runbook with fallback endpoint and HPA hold steps.
alex: agreed. I'll own the pre-rotation check and canary plan.
sre-bot: incident resolved: keystore-rotation-cascade (severity: S2). duration ~00:25. Logs and incident notes uploaded: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/keystore-rotation-incident-1766665432
rani: thanks team. closing thread once runbook PR is merged.
